content.text: The Mistake Almost Every Creator Makes First

They invest time and resources into setting up accounts with services that are either unavailable or heavily restricted. This choice results in prolonged frustration, delays in receiving payments, and ultimately, loss of potential customers. Instead, creators should explore blockchain-based payment solutions that not only bypass these barriers but also provide faster transaction times and lower fees. The reliance on platforms that restrict access can be detrimental to their business model.
Why This Keeps Happening Even to Experienced Sellers

Even seasoned sellers fall into the trap of conventional wisdom regarding payment processing. They often overlook the fundamental shift brought by blockchain technology, viewing their options through a narrow lens. These creators may have built successful businesses, but their dependency on restricted platforms limits their growth potential. The reluctance to embrace new technology and rethink payment structures is a systemic issue, fueled by misinformation and lack of awareness about available alternatives. This cycle can be broken by understanding and utilizing decentralized payment methods.
The Real Cost of Getting This Wrong

Each week that a Bangladeshi freelancer cannot accept payments translates to lost sales, diminished brand reputation, and a dwindling customer base. Additionally, relying on traditional banking networks can expose freelancers to high fees and long wait times. By ignoring the potential of blockchain payments, creators risk not only their income but also their relevance in an increasingly competitive market.
